name: Merge intervals (unsorted, touching)
instruction: Implement merge_intervals(intervals) in intervals.py. Input is a list of [start, end] pairs that may be UNSORTED. Merge overlapping AND touching intervals ([1,2] and [2,3] merge into [1,3]; a fully-nested interval is absorbed). Return a new list of merged [start, end] sorted by start. Empty input returns []. An in-repo test (test_intervals.py) is provided — run it before claiming done.
